description: Waitlist CLI for Texas Roadhouse. Find a nearby store, read the quote, join and leave the list.

tools.name: mapbox_get_mapbox.places
tools.description: GET /api/mapbox/geocoding/v5/mapbox.places/{id}. Required: id. Optional: country, types. Returns array of MapboxPlaceFeature.

tools.name: stores_list_near
tools.description: GET /api/stores/near. Optional: lat, limit, long (plus 5 more). Returns array of NearRestaurant.

tools.name: texasroadhouse_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a waitlist request (destructive). Live cancel requires yes=true; dry-run=true previews without POSTing. Required: waitlistRequestId, siteId. Optional: clientid, yes, dry-run. Returns the new WaitlistCancelResult.

params.name: yes
params.description: Required for a live cancel. Same meaning as CLI --yes.

params.name: dry-run
params.description: Preview the request body without POSTing. Same meaning as CLI --dry-run.

tools.name: texasroadhouse_checkin
tools.description: Check in once the party is at the host stand (destructive). Live check-in requires yes=true; dry-run=true previews without POSTing. Required: waitlist_id. Optional: yes, dry-run. Returns the new WaitlistCheckinResult.

params.name: waitlist_id
params.description: Store extref (not internal store id). Springfield MO is 218.

params.name: yes
params.description: Required for a live check-in. Same meaning as CLI --yes.

params.name: dry-run
params.description: Preview the request body without POSTing. Same meaning as CLI --dry-run.

tools.name: texasroadhouse_get_quote
tools.description: GET /api/texasroadhouse/waitlist/{waitlist_id}/quote. Required: waitlist_id. Returns the Quote.

tools.name: texasroadhouse_get_settings
tools.description: GET /api/texasroadhouse/waitlist/{waitlist_id}/settings. Required: waitlist_id. Returns array of SettingSpecialSeatingType.

tools.name: texasroadhouse_get_status
tools.description: GET waitlist request status. Query clientid=texasroadhouse. Required: waitlist_id, request_id. Optional: clientid. Returns the WaitlistStatus.

params.name: waitlist_id
params.description: Store extref (not internal store id). Springfield MO is 218.

params.name: request_id
params.description: Waitlist request id from a successful submit.

tools.name: texasroadhouse_get_test
tools.description: GET /api/texasroadhouse/waitlist/{waitlist_id}/test. Required: waitlist_id. Returns the Test.

tools.name: texasroadhouse_submit
tools.description: Join a store waitlist (destructive). Live join requires yes=true; dry-run=true previews without POSTing. Required: waitlist_id, EmailAddress, FirstName, LastName, PrimaryPhoneAreaCode, PrimaryPhoneNumber, PartySize, WaitMinutes. Optional: IsSmoking, PrimaryPhoneExtension, PrimaryPhoneType, Platform, yes, dry-run. Returns the new WaitlistSubmitResult.

params.name: waitlist_id
params.description: Store extref (not internal store id). Springfield MO is 218.

params.name: IsSmoking
params.description: Always false in the web app

params.name: WaitMinutes
params.description: From quote MinQuote for this party size

params.name: yes
params.description: Required for a live join. Same meaning as CLI --yes.

params.name: dry-run
params.description: Preview the request body without POSTing. Same meaning as CLI --dry-run.
